clue.text: Tree dweller's westbound US ruffle work

indicators.note: in an across clue westbound means travelling right to left, so the whole run is read backwards

parts.note: to muss, chiefly American, is to ruffle or tousle hair
OP is short for opus, a work

explanation.surface: Someone describes an American crumpled piece of work heading west.
explanation.walkthrough: 'westbound' turns MUSS + OP backwards as one run.
explanation.definitionFit: The possum is a marsupial that lives largely in trees.

clue.text: Lap dancing, familiar actress shows humour

indicators.note: the letters dance into a new order

parts.note: Cate Blanchett, an actress known familiarly by first name

explanation.surface: A lap dance by a well-known actress shows her sense of fun.
explanation.definitionFit: To humour someone is to soothe or appease them by going along with them.

clue.text: People of the far north welcoming Latin dish

indicators.note: the people take in the letter, welcoming it inside

parts.note: the Sami are the reindeer-herding people of Lapland

explanation.surface: Arctic people welcome a Latin visitor with a meal.
explanation.definitionFit: A salmi is a ragout of game birds, a cooked dish.

clue.text: In France one twice traps bum, not being initiated

indicators.note: the doubled word catches the other piece between its copies
the French word is used two times over

parts.note: un is French for one
to bum, or cadge, is to beg

explanation.surface: In France, someone twice catches a backside before anything starts.
explanation.definitionFit: Something unbegun has not yet been started.

clue.text: Puck immersed in pool — oxygen goes clear

indicators.note: the oxygen symbol leaves, so that letter is dropped
the sprite is put down inside the bathing place, as if swimming in it

parts.note: a lido is an open-air swimming pool
Puck is the mischievous sprite of A Midsummer Night's Dream, an imp
O is the chemical symbol for oxygen

explanation.surface: A mischievous sprite sinks into a swimming pool and the oxygen disappears.
explanation.walkthrough: 'immersed in' sinks the sprite into the pool, and 'goes' then drops the oxygen symbol from the end.
explanation.definitionFit: Limpid water is transparent, letting light straight through.

clue.text: Which, in Guangzhou, covers ancient Chinese text

indicators.note: the words cover, or conceal, a run of letters within them

explanation.surface: A question about which book in Guangzhou covers an old Chinese text.
explanation.definitionFit: The I Ching, or Book of Changes, is a classical Chinese divination book.

clue.text: Don't bow to make such an effect as a player

definitions.text: Don't bow to make such an effect as a player

parts.words: Don't bow to make such an effect as a player
parts.note: a string player plucks rather than bowing; bow seems to mean bending

explanation.surface: A performer refuses to bow to make an impression.
explanation.definitionFit: Pizzicato is the technique of plucking violin strings instead of using the bow.

clue.text: Study medic over a hospital extension

parts.note: DR is short for doctor
a wing is an extension of a hospital building

explanation.surface: A doctor considers a new hospital wing.
explanation.definitionFit: A study is a sketch or drawing made as practice.

clue.text: See 11
Artist's audio version of Dark Cloud, Earth

indicators.note: an audio version is how words sound, so the spoken forms are swapped for lookalike spellings

parts.note: a pall is a dark cloud, as of smoke; clay is earth

explanation.surface: An artist releases a sound recording of an album called Dark Cloud, Earth.
explanation.walkthrough: PALL and CLAY said together sound like the painter's name.
explanation.definitionFit: Paul Klee was a Swiss-German painter of the twentieth century.

clue.text: Warned feaster: "Signs of sleep as herbal mixture takes hold"

indicators.note: the mixed letters grip the sleep signs, holding them within
a herbal mixture: the letters of the two words are blended together

parts.note: ZZ is the cartoon sign of someone snoring

explanation.surface: A feaster is warned that his herbal mixture will make him drowsy.
explanation.walkthrough: 'mixture' turns AS HERBAL into BELSHAAR, which 'takes hold' of ZZ.
explanation.definitionFit: In the Book of Daniel, King Belshazzar's feast was interrupted by a hand writing a warning on the wall.

clue.text: 9 25's rather pedestrian description of 7

parts.note: Klee's famous remark describes drawing as a stroll with a pencil; pedestrian puns on walking

explanation.surface: A painter gives a rather dull account of sketching.
explanation.definitionFit: Paul Klee described drawing as an active line out on a stroll, a famous saying in art teaching.

clue.text: Riding on rocks, kept in shape by pressure only

definitions.text: kept in shape by pressure only

indicators.note: on the rocks means wrecked or ruined, so the letters are broken up

explanation.surface: Someone goes riding over rocky ground and holds firm under pressure.
explanation.definitionFit: A non-rigid airship, or blimp, keeps its form only by internal gas pressure, having no frame.

clue.text: Slippers on, if your houses represent someone

indicators.note: the words house, or hold within them, a run of letters

explanation.surface: Wearing slippers, your homes take on human character.
explanation.definitionFit: To personify is to embody or represent something as a human figure.

clue.text: Bag bracelet rings right, which is sweet

parts.note: a sac is a bag-like part

indicators.note: the chain encircles the letter for right

parts.note: a chain is worn round the wrist as a bracelet

explanation.surface: A bag with a bracelet and rings is a lovely thing.
explanation.definitionFit: Saccharin is an artificial sweetener; as an adjective it means sugary or cloying.

clue.text: Put up support and lag

parts.note: to hang a picture is to put it up
to back someone is to support them

explanation.surface: Someone hangs a shelf, braces it, and falls behind schedule.
explanation.definitionFit: To hang back is to hold back or linger behind others.

clue.text: See 15
Confirm wild animal escaped?

parts.note: a bear is a wild animal
out means free or loose

explanation.surface: A wild beast has got loose; can someone confirm?
explanation.definitionFit: To bear out a claim is to support or corroborate it.

clue.text: Harry Price to accept rewritten obit: "Life still to come"

indicators.note: the mixed surname takes in the other letters
to harry is to harass, so the letters are knocked about
the death notice is written again with its letters in a new order

explanation.surface: Harry Price, the ghost hunter, gets a revised obituary saying he will live again.
explanation.walkthrough: Harry Price was a famous British ghost hunter, which suits the surface's talk of life still to come; 'Harry', 'rewritten' and 'to accept' all act.
explanation.definitionFit: Prebiotic describes the time or chemistry before living things existed.

clue.text: Stop painting and reacquaint yourself with an old skill!

definitions.meaning: lift the paintbrush off the canvas

definitions.text: reacquaint yourself with an old skill

explanation.definitionFit: To brush up a subject is to revise and relearn it; brush up also pictures a painter lifting the brush.

clue.text: Pakistan's opener in cricket survey?

indicators.note: the letter goes inside the other word

parts.note: a cricket is an insect

indicators.note: the opener of a word is its first letter, as an opening batsman goes in first

explanation.surface: A Pakistan opening batsman reviews his innings at cricket.
explanation.walkthrough: Cricket here is the chirping insect, not the bat-and-ball game.
explanation.definitionFit: To inspect is to examine closely, to look over.

clue.text: Rip off clothing item

explanation.definitionFit: To fleece someone is to cheat them; a fleece is also a soft warm top.

clue.text: It affects liquidity of carbon residue on reversing bolt

parts.note: C is the chemical symbol for carbon
ash is what is left after burning

indicators.note: the word for eating fast is turned backwards

parts.note: to bolt food is to wolf it

explanation.surface: Carbon deposits on a bolt being reversed affect a liquid's flow.
explanation.definitionFit: Money moving in and out of a business governs whether it has enough ready funds.

clue.text: Superior's in a good mood? Don't talk rot!

parts.note: feeling up is being cheerful
pish is an exclamation of contempt for nonsense

explanation.surface: Someone haughty is cheerful, but dismisses nonsense.
explanation.definitionFit: Uppish is a British word for arrogant or self-assertive, acting above others.

clue.text: Game, digitally rude sort

definitions.meaning: one who prods people with a finger

explanation.definitionFit: Poker is a card game; one who prods with a finger is also one.

clue.text: Harlot, hope abandoned, had by bad people

indicators.note: abandoned means wild or unrestrained, so the letters run loose

explanation.surface: A harlot, giving up on hope, is used by wicked men.
explanation.definitionFit: People who are unwell, feeling bad, suffer illness.

clue.text: See 9
Show can almost be bought

parts.note: a tin is a can

indicators.note: almost means the last letter is left off

parts.note: goods that sell are being bought

explanation.surface: A show might nearly be for sale.
explanation.definitionFit: Tinsel is showy glitter, meaning superficial display.

clue.text: Spar deployed around isle (Rum?)

indicators.note: a spar spread out around something holds it inside

parts.note: a sprit is a spar that extends a sail

explanation.surface: A ship's spar is rigged around an island called Rum.
explanation.walkthrough: Rum is also a Scottish island, which the surface plays on.
explanation.definitionFit: Rum is an example of a distilled alcoholic drink, hence the question mark.
